sample_unit: AAO articles per language, each simplified 10 times

links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT-simplified patient education articles, English and Spanish
links.effect: Mean grade level English 8.43±1.17 to 8.9±2.1 (p=0.41, not simplified); Spanish 5.3±0.34 to 4.1±1.1 (p=0.0001, significantly simplified). Spanish also improved on Legibilidad-µ (p=0.003).
links.quote: The readability of AAO articles in English worsened without significance but significantly improved in Spanish.

screen.reason: Empirical study using automated readability formulas to evaluate ChatGPT-3.5's ability to simplify ophthalmology patient educational materials in English and Spanish.
